description: Defines the SceneSet plugin class, including configuration, notification handling, and lifecycle management for app scenes within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: SceneSet
classes.description: Main plugin class managing app scenes, lifecycle events, and configuration.

classes.name: SceneSet::Configuration
classes.description: Configuration container holding the reference app name.

classes.name: SceneSet::NotificationHandler
classes.description: Handles app lifecycle notifications and forwards them to the parent SceneSet.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given service shell.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: OnAppLifecycleStateChanged
methods.description: Handles app lifecycle state change events.

methods.name: MonitorReferenceAppCrash
methods.description: Monitors the reference app for crashes.

methods.name: RestartReferenceApp
methods.description: Restarts the reference application after a crash.
